_note: Claude reads this index while planning, then opens entries/<id>.json for the ones it picks.

entries.name: Seeder
entries.summary: Deterministic random numbers with named sub-streams.

entries.name: Level design
entries.summary: Seeded room-and-corridor dungeons with start and stairs placement (stairs in the room farthest by walking distance).

entries.name: D&D combat system
entries.summary: d20 + attack bonus vs armor class; natural 20 crits (double dice), natural 1 misses.

entries.name: Loot roller
entries.summary: Weighted loot tables with a 'nothing' weight.

entries.name: Inventory
entries.summary: Capacity-limited pack with weapon and armor equip slots.

entries.name: Concept art -> 3D pipeline
entries.summary: GPT asset concept (Meshy-friendly template, approved concepts as style references) -> user approval -> Meshy image-to-3D using that exact image -> Blender headless cleanup (scale, pivot, decimate to poly budget, palette snap, LODs, GLB).

entries.name: UI/HUD kit
entries.summary: HP bar, stats line, inventory panel, combat log, game-over screen and touch pad, driven only by events.

entries.name: Audio pipeline (ElevenLabs)
entries.summary: Sound effects, music and character voice lines from ElevenLabs in the bible's audio style, finished to loudness-normalized OGG (music with loop points).

entries.name: External imports
entries.summary: User uploads (music, SFX, 3D models, textures, fonts, reference images) with required source and license.

entries.name: GBA-style basic animation
entries.summary: Few-frame, snappy procedural animation for low-poly characters, time-stepped at 12 fps so it reads like sprite frames: 2-frame idle bob, 4-frame hop with squash on landing, 3-frame attack lunge, 2-frame white hit flash, 5-frame death pop.
